'''Water Wave''' is a [[Water spells|water]]-based [[Wave spells|wave spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 65 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the second-strongest water spell in the game, with the strongest being [[Water Surge]].

==Damage==
Water Wave's base maximum hit starts at 18 and increases as the player unlocks additional wave spells, up to 20 at level 75 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Water Wave's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a water-based spell, Water Wave's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to water]].
